title: 1823 Prairie's stoop: a longer landing a few steps under the door
items: The Dent house at 1823 Prairie: the stoop's landing now runs the full 2.7 m to the pavilion and stands a few steps below the hall. The door opens onto it at 1.7 m, so the flight from the north is nine steps instead of thirteen, as both old pictures of the house draw it.
The grilled arch under the landing has moved to where both pictures put it, a little south of the landing's middle, and is a quarter of a metre broader. The doorway above it is now 3.2 m tall.
